newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 27.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Ivory Coast sets up unit to crack down on fraud in textile industry. Names illegal African and Lebanese traders after seizing 3,836 rolls of cloth worth 26 CFA million without correct origin denomination. Plans review of relevant laws.

- Ivorian Anti-Pollution Centre lauches Belgian-funded 210 million CFA campaign against marine and lagoon pollution. Data collection, personnel training and surveillance flights planned to cut down on oil pollution. New environment taxes being considered for 1998.
- Ivory Coast considers plans to give the state a greater role in judicial decision-making.
- Pay strike since March 4 continues at Abidjan-based French shipbuilding and repair yard CARENA, which serves offshore sector.

- ECOWAS (Economic Community of West African States) meets donors to discuss eight billion CFA of financing needed for regional agricultural development, weather monitoring and environmental projects. Ends on Friday.
- United States offers Ivory Coast marine patrol launches to help police border with Liberia.
